    The minimal quotient with its support and line #

    exists_pointBrick with more output: the point–brick data live on the minimal set T' (the brick vanishes outside T', the point lies in T'; PointBrickAIn), and if T' has at least 30 points, the Euler form of the quotient gives a line (exists_critical_line). This is exists_pointBrick_line.
